title: Worksheet versioning + diff history
description: Every worksheet carries v1, v2, v3 stamps; teachers can see what changed between AI re-edits. Side-by-side diff renderer (similar to the Differentiate diff already shipped in PR #39) with per-section change highlights.
rationale: User's improvement #13. AI edits today silently overwrite. A trust-restoring upgrade — the teacher can revert, compare, or send the diff to a HOD as evidence.
steps: Schema: add `worksheets.versions JSONB` (array of { v: number; createdAt; trigger: 'manual-save'|'ai-edit'|'reteach'|'differentiate'; sections; metadata }) — keep current state in `content`/`sections` and snapshot to `versions` on every change. Drizzle migration.
Server: PUT /api/worksheets/:id appends to versions before applying the new content; cap at 20 versions, drop oldest.

Client lib client/src/lib/worksheetVersioning.ts: diffWorksheets(a, b): { sections: { idx; status: 'unchanged'|'edited'|'added'|'removed'; before?; after? }[] }. Reuse the wordlevel diff algorithm from differentiate-v2-enhancements.ts.
- History.tsx row gains a 'v3' badge; clicking opens a Versions drawer.

- Versions drawer: timeline of versions, diff panel between any two, 'Revert to this version' button (issues a PUT that appends current as a new version with trigger 'revert' + restores the chosen one).
do_not_touch: Existing Differentiate diff renderer (we reuse the diff helper)
acceptance_criteria: Editing a worksheet via AI edit produces a v2 in History.
Versions drawer shows all versions; selecting two highlights changed sections.
Revert restores the chosen version and increments to vN+1.
Cap at 20 versions enforced; oldest dropped.
verification: Manual: generate, AI-edit twice, open versions drawer, diff and revert.
